name: Dixie | 200mg Exotics Gummies | Mangosteen Dream
description:
200mg Indica Gummies.
10ct x 20mg per piece

Drift into a state of tranquil relaxation with Mangosteen Dream. This soothing indica gummy pairs the exotic flavor of mangosteen with the lush sweetness of peach, creating a balanced blend of tart and sweet notes. Crafted to melt away tension and promote deep rest, Mangosteen Dream is your perfect companion for unwinding and embracing a peaceful, dreamlike state.
